You are a sales representative receiving numerous calls and you find it hard to remember at the end of each day who called you and whom you need to call back. You do not want to overload your address book with contacts for short-term projects.

This app will support you with your daily business. It enables you to take notes about your calls and return calls directly from your app.

Copy phone numbers from the Apple phone app to the clipboard and open our app “Call Todo”. A new contact will be created automatically. There is no simpler way to do this (Apple does not allow direct readout from the phone app).

Features:
- Creating contacts using a phone number from the clipboard
- Project-related management of contacts
- For each contact a history of events can be compiled.
- Filter for projects, calls to do and full text search
- Project management using colors
- Direct calls to contacts in the app
- Direct e-mails from the app
- Adding of contacts to address book

'Call Todo' offers the same functionality as 'Call Todo Pro' but it displays advertisements.
